prompt: To study moisture content, samples of maple were collected from $24$ trees, and one sample was cut in the shape of a cube. The maple sample has a density of $742$ kilograms per cubic meter, and each edge of the cube has a length of $0.80$ meters. To the nearest whole number, what is the mass, in kilograms, of this sample?
explanation: Choice A is correct. The sample is a cube with edge length $0.80$ meters, so its volume is $(0.80)^{3} = 0.512$ cubic meters. Since the density is $742$ kilograms per cubic meter, the mass is $0.512 \times 742 = 379.904$ kilograms. Rounded to the nearest whole number, the mass of the sample is $380$ kilograms.
